name: Stimulants
description: Stimulants explained: ADHD medicines, modafinil, phentermine, methamphetamine, and cocaine. Effects, heart risks, misuse, and legal access.
intro: Stimulants increase dopamine and norepinephrine in the brain, raising alertness, attention, and energy. Prescription stimulants are the most effective treatment for ADHD; illicit stimulants such as methamphetamine and cocaine are highly addictive and strain the heart.

blocks.p: Prescription amphetamines and methylphenidates are Schedule II. In 2023 the FDA updated their boxed warning to emphasize the risks of misuse, addiction, and overdose, especially by snorting or injecting.

blocks.warn: Street stimulants and counterfeit Adderall pills are increasingly contaminated with fentanyl. Carry naloxone even if you do not use opioids.
